89da348fc4.q: What is the unique training model that Condition Gym uses in their group fitness classes?
89da348fc4.a: Condition splits the room five days a week into two simultaneous classes: Lift (strength training) and Engine (conditioning sessions). Members book whichever session suits their goals. Saturday features community-based team sessions, and Sunday offers Base, a hybrid session combining both. The programming uses progressive overload training, decreasing reps over eight-week phases while increasing weight, with eight-week testing cycles allowing members to test their three rep maxes on compound lifts and conditioning benchmarks.

78c725c8b9.q: Why did Daniel Capilli transition from the Navy to the fitness industry and what drives his group training philosophy?
78c725c8b9.a: Capilli was always passionate about sport and fitness, which intensified during his Navy service. After 10 and a half years, he took 12 months' notice and used that time to complete fitness certifications. He chose group training specifically because it mirrors the team environment he valued in the military. Unlike big box gyms where he struggles with momentum and gets distracted by his phone, group fitness provides structure, community connection, competitiveness, and the feeling of being part of a team—elements essential to his training philosophy.

82b6753136.q: What was Daniel Capilli's career path in the Royal Australian Navy and how did he build his initial fitness business?
82b6753136.a: Capilli joined the Navy at age 17-18 as an electronics technician after seeing a recruitment advertisement on television. He trained at HMAS Cerberus for approximately two years, then was posted to Sydney where he completed additional certifications at a Fleet Support Unit before posting to a ship. After leaving the Navy, he worked 12 to 16 months as a personal trainer for another company to learn the industry, then co-founded his first gym business with two business partners—both civilians—leveraging their complementary strengths and advice from mentors to navigate business ownership without formal business training.

d55a90322a.q: How does Condition Gym's tracking app enhance member progression and accountability?
d55a90322a.a: Condition is launching a new branded app to track all lifts and test scores from the eight-week testing cycles. Based on individual test results (three rep max on compound lifts and conditioning benchmarks), the app automatically prescribes the specific weights members should use daily, adjusted for the prescribed reps and RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion) for that session. This feature aims to enhance the member experience and provide clear visibility into progression over time.

54f22473c4.q: What is Daniel Capilli's gym triangle framework for evaluating successful fitness communities?
54f22473c4.a: Capilli describes gyms as requiring three essential elements: community, results, and trainers. Without any one of these three elements functioning properly, the gym environment does not work effectively. He emphasizes that community creates the connected feeling of a sports team, results demonstrate progress and improvement, and quality trainers deliver both coaching and accountability—together forming the foundation of a successful fitness brand.
